title: Ruthenium(II)/diphosphine/naphthoquinone complexes: synthesis, characterization, anticancer activity and molecular docking studies.
authors: Costa, Analu Rocha; de Oliveira, Leticia Pires; Palmeira-Mello, Marcos V; de Araujo-Neto, Joao Honorato; Lima, Mauro A; Moraes, Carlos Andre; de Farias, Renan Lira; Demidoff, Felipe C; Neto, Chaquip D; Cominetti, Marcia R; de Melo, Matheus Reis Santos; Nicolella, Heloiza Diniz; Mendes Abe, Saulo H; Fonseca, Elisania Kelly Barbosa; Arruda, Marco Aurelio Zezzi; Ellena, Javier Alcides; Tavares, Denise Crispim; Rocha, Fillipe V; Batista, Alzir Azevedo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钌配合物的合成、抗癌活性及与DNA小沟的分子对接，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且方法仅简单对接，深度不足。
abstract: Breast cancer (BC) is one of the most challenging types of cancer in women. Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive and rapidly progressive subtype that lacks targeted therapies, relying primarily on chemotherapy. Given the limited treatment options for TNBC, novel therapeutic strategies are needed to address this disease. In this context, here we report the synthesis and characterization of four ruthenium(II) complexes containing naphthoquinone derivatives as ligands: [Ru(NQ1)(bipy)(dppen)]PF(6) (Ru1), [Ru(NQ2)(bipy)(dppen)]PF(6) (Ru2), [Ru(NQ1)(bipy)(DPEphos)]PF(6) (Ru3), and [Ru(NQ2)(bipy)(DPEphos)]PF(6) (Ru4), where bipy = 2,2'-bipyridine, dppen = 1,2-bis(diphenylphosphino)ethylene, DPEphos = bis[(2-diphenylphosphino)phenyl]ether, and NQ1 and NQ2 = deprotonated lawsone and lapachol, respectively. Mass spectrometry and elemental analyses were used to confirm the purity of the complexes. In vitro assays showed that Ru1-Ru4 were cytotoxic against MDA-MB-231 and MCF-7 (breast cancer cell lines) and A549 (lung cell line). The compounds exhibited lower IC(50) values than cisplatin, used as a control. Ru4 was the most promising compound, with the highest selectivity index for the triple-negative breast cancer cell line (SI = 25.5). Furthermore, this complex inhibited colony formation, induced apoptosis, and affected the cell cycle in these cancer cells. Western blot analysis showed increased cleaved caspase-3 expression, corroborating the apoptotic mechanism observed by flow cytometry. Furthermore, cell uptake studies showed that ruthenium was found at the intracellular level after treatment with the MDA-MB-231 cell line. DNA-binding studies revealed an interaction between Ru1-Ru4 and Ct-DNA via the minor groove pocket, as confirmed by molecular docking. Overall, our results suggest [Ru(NQ2)(bipy)(DPEphos)]PF(6) (Ru4) to be a promising cytotoxic agent against breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌（BC）是女性中最具挑战性的癌症类型之一。三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是一种侵袭性强、进展迅速的亚型，缺乏靶向治疗手段，主要依赖化疗。鉴于TNBC的治疗选择有限，需要新的治疗策略来应对这一疾病。在此背景下，我们报告了四种含萘醌衍生物作为配体的钌(II)配合物的合成与表征：[Ru(NQ1)(bipy)(dppen)]PF(6) (Ru1)、[Ru(NQ2)(bipy)(dppen)]PF(6) (Ru2)、[Ru(NQ1)(bipy)(DPEphos)]PF(6) (Ru3) 和 [Ru(NQ2)(bipy)(DPEphos)]PF(6) (Ru4)，其中bipy = 2,2'-联吡啶，dppen = 1,2-双(二苯基膦)乙烯，DPEphos = 双[(2-二苯基膦)苯基]醚，NQ1和NQ2分别为去质子化的拉索醌和拉帕醌。质谱和元素分析用于确认配合物的纯度。体外实验表明，Ru1-Ru4对MDA-MB-231和MCF-7（乳腺癌细胞系）以及A549（肺癌细胞系）具有细胞毒性。这些化合物的IC(50)值低于作为对照的顺铂。Ru4是最有前景的化合物，对三阴性乳腺癌细胞系的选择性指数最高（SI = 25.5）。此外，该配合物抑制了这些癌细胞的集落形成，诱导了凋亡，并影响了细胞周期。Western blot分析显示裂解的caspase-3表达增加，这与流式细胞术观察到的凋亡机制一致。此外，细胞摄取研究表明，在与MDA-MB-231细胞系处理后，钌在细胞内水平被发现。DNA结合研究揭示了Ru1-Ru4与Ct-DNA通过小沟槽口袋的相互作用，这通过分子对接得到确认。总体而言，我们的结果表明[Ru(NQ2)(bipy)(DPEphos)]PF(6) (Ru4)是对抗乳腺癌的有前景的细胞毒性剂。
